gateReason: Official Tokyo Open Data tsunami 10m mesh CSV resources were directly accessible without token or login and were clipped to the official MLIT N03 Chuo City polygon to produce an extracted Chuo spatial hazard layer v1.

sources.title: Tokyo Open Data ward-area tsunami distribution CSVs, including maximum tsunami height, maximum inundation depth, and arrival-time layers
sources.municipalitySelection: Chuo City is selected by clipping mesh points to the official MLIT N03 Chuo polygon.
sources.notes: Primary P8-B evidence source. Used to extract Chuo spatial maximum inundation depth, maximum tsunami height, and arrival-time sample points. Maximum tsunami height remains separate from the inundation-depth grid.

sources.title: National Land Numerical Information N03 administrative boundary, Tokyo, 2024
sources.notes: Official administrative boundary used to clip Tokyo tsunami mesh points to Chuo City. It is not a tsunami source by itself.

sources.title: Tokyo Metropolitan Government 2022 damage estimation report tsunami sections
sources.notes: Official metropolitan report source. Values guide P8-B provenance and scenario labels, but maximum tsunami height is not a substitute for an extracted inundation-depth surface.

sources.title: Chuo City page on tsunami and liquefaction
sources.notes: Chuo City references the Tokyo Metropolitan Government damage estimation report for tsunami numerical simulation results. It is a provenance bridge, not a standalone Chuo tsunami hazard map dataset.

sources.title: Supplementary public PDF reference for Tokyo Bay tsunami height by municipality
sources.notes: Supplementary reference for the older 2.46m Chuo maximum tsunami-height value. Treat as a height reference only until source lineage and scenario assumptions are reviewed.

sources.title: Chuo flood hazard map materials, non-tsunami proxy fallback only
sources.notes: Flood material is not the tsunami evidence source for P8-B. Keep only as a non-tsunami proxy fallback if Tokyo tsunami evidence cannot be extracted for a later prototype.

notes: P8-B prioritizes Tokyo Metropolitan Government tsunami damage estimation evidence for Chuo. Chuo's lack of a standalone tsunami hazard map is not treated as absence of tsunami evidence.
